questions.question: How do you determine what your priorities are?
questions.answer: ADR-0187/0188/0189/0190/0191 sequence priorities; PRD + Phase-01 spec authoritative.

questions.question: How do you structure your organization to support your business outcomes?
questions.answer: axis-identity owns the µservice; ops-security shares; council-architecture approves.

questions.question: How do you implement observability in your workload?
questions.answer: 9 OpenSLO targets; 3 Grafana dashboards; audit-chain seal of 18 event types; 4 core signals wired.

questions.question: How do you know that you are ready to support a workload?
questions.answer: IP-016 scale validation is GATE before pack-eu bellwether; 9 SLOs; 8 runbooks; quarterly DR drill.

questions.question: Identity and Access Management
questions.answer: This µservice IS the IdAM substrate. Passkey-first; ACR step-up; Cedar PDP; SCIM lifecycle.

questions.question: How do you manage credentials?
questions.answer: OpenBao SecretReference per ADR-0117; HSM-backed in regulated packs.

questions.question: How do you protect data in transit?
questions.answer: TLS 1.3 minimum; mTLS via SPIFFE per ADR-0148.

questions.question: How do you protect data at rest?
How do you detect anomalous behaviour?
questions.answer: IP-014 continuous risk-scoring (CAEP); rate-limit + WAF at edge; sign-count regression alarm.

questions.question: Audit logging
questions.answer: Audit-chain Merkle + Ed25519 seal of 18 event types; per-tenant slicing.

questions.question: Foundation: service quotas
questions.answer: Per-tenant + per-IP rate-limits at edge; shuffle-sharding in Postgres pool.

questions.question: How do you design your services to prevent failures?
questions.answer: HA 3 replicas per pack; Patroni Postgres failover; circuit-breaker on Zitadel upstream.

questions.question: How do you back up data?
questions.answer: Postgres WAL archive + PITR; warm-standby in failover region.

questions.question: How do you use failure isolation?
questions.answer: Per-pack independent deployment; no cross-pack replication.

performance_efficiency.notes: PROJECTION-based until IP-016 reports. Year-1 targets ambitious for Zitadel scale; will validate.

cost_optimization.notes: 5-year TCO modelled in cost-budget.md; vendor lock-in avoidance ~$50M over 5y.

sustainability.notes: Per-pack HA topology accepts cross-AZ replication energy cost; PUE-friendly regions chosen where possible.
